DPWM.name: Pumpkin plant
DPWM.description: a pumpkin plant growing in a small mound of brown garden soil, broad lobed green leaves and curling vines, orange pumpkin variety
DPWM.prompt: One single image showing 6 stages of the same Pumpkin plant (a pumpkin plant growing in a small mound of brown garden soil, broad lobed green leaves and curling vines, orange pumpkin variety), arranged in ONE horizontal row from left to right in this exact order, with a clear empty gap between neighbours so nothing overlaps or touches: 1. Sprout: a tiny seedling with two small round green seed leaves just breaking through the soil (about 8% of the tallest one's height); 2. Small: a young plant with a few broad leaves, short vines and one small green pumpkin the size of a fist (about 30% of the tallest one's height); 3. Medium: a leafy spreading plant with long vines and a medium half-orange, half-green pumpkin (about 60% of the tallest one's height); 4. Mature: a lush full plant with large leaves, long vines and a big ripe bright orange pumpkin (about 100% of the tallest one's height); 5. Withered: the mature plant drying out: yellowing, curling, drooping leaves and a slightly dull shrunken pumpkin (about 85% of the tallest one's height); 6. Dead: the plant fully dead: brown brittle collapsed leaves and vines lying flat, a shriveled rotting brown pumpkin (about 60% of the tallest one's height). All 6 are the SAME object (same design, base, colours and style); only the growth/state changes. SCALE: they all stand on one shared ground line and are drawn with the same camera, zoom and angle, each at its true size relative to the others, so a small stage stays small and is NOT enlarged to match the biggest; do not crop any of them. STYLE: a true low-poly 3D model render, like a low-polygon game asset. The whole object is built from a small number of large flat triangular and angular polygon facets with hard visible edges between them; every surface is flat-shaded, each facet a single flat colour with soft simple lighting, so you can count the planes. Chunky simplified shapes, no fine detail, no smooth curves or gradients, no realistic textures, no fur/leaf/bark detail, no outlines, not painterly, not photographic, not pixel art, not a cartoon illustration. Limited natural colour palette. Soft top-left key light. Isometric 3/4 front view, modern-day items, plain flat solid light-grey background, no shadow on the ground, no text except the tag. In the bottom-left corner, write the code DPWM in small, plain, dark, sans-serif capital letters on the flat background, well clear of the object. Write it exactly, nothing else.
